reasons: Rule NOSOLICIT's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer; the cited paragraph (p0066) is an independent-contractor/no-agency clause that imposes no solicitation, hiring or inducement restriction, so the absence of a covenant is the best outcome for us and correctly classified as compliant.
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original.

The two failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) measure terms internal to a restrictive covenant that does not exist in this document, so their failure is an artifact rather than evidence of a deviation — the rationale correctly explains this.

Rationale documents the sweep of detection terms and the hits that are unrelated (indemnity, confidentiality, access controls), and records the fallback/walk-away guidance for future negotiation without raising a non-issue.
